name: PasswordStrength

props.description: The current password value to evaluate.
props.name: value

props.description: Render an optional checklist of rule checks below the bar.
props.name: showChecklist

props.description: Text labels for the three score buckets.
props.name: labels
props.type: { weak: string; fair: string; strong: string }

tagline: Evaluates password quality with a 0-4 score and optional rule checklist. Use with PasswordInput in secure forms.
usage: DO show PasswordStrength immediately below PasswordInput so users understand password quality before submitting.
DO keep `rules` stable (default list is recommended for broad UI compatibility).
DON'T treat the score as cryptographic strength; use it as a UI hint only.
